# DOCXKIT_PREVIEW_FETCH_FAILED: Preview fetch failed

The DOCX URL could not be fetched successfully.

## What to do

1. Check the HTTP response, network, authentication, and CORS settings.
2. Use local DOCX bytes when remote fetching is unavailable.

## Problem example

```ts
import { createDocx, createDocxPreview } from 'docx-kit'

const container = document.createElement('div')
document.body.append(container)

const preview = createDocxPreview(container)
try {
  await preview.render('https://example.com/missing.docx')
} finally { preview.destroy() }
```

## Corrected example

```ts
import { createDocx, createDocxPreview } from 'docx-kit'

const container = document.createElement('div')
document.body.append(container)

const preview = createDocxPreview(container)
try {
  const blob = await createDocx().p('Hello').toBlob()
  await preview.render(blob)
} finally { preview.destroy() }
```

## Common causes

- A non-success HTTP response, network failure, or blocked cross-origin request.

## Diagnostic fields

- `code`: `PREVIEW_FETCH_FAILED`
- `diagnosticCode`: `DOCXKIT_PREVIEW_FETCH_FAILED`
- `name`: `DocxKitError`
- `docs`: https://docx-kit.ntnyq.dev/errors/docxkit_preview_fetch_failed/

### Example message

```text
Failed to fetch DOCX: HTTP 404
```
